title: Creamy Vegan Pesto Recipe - Made With Cashews!
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldName: Vegan Pesto Recipe (Creamy, Easy & Better Than Store-Bought)
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 cups (1.6 oz) fresh basil leaves (loosely packed)
¼ cup raw cashews ((or pine nuts or walnuts))
½ teaspoon salt (plus more to taste)
2 - 3 tablespoons water (as needed to thin (or more olive oil))
ldInstructionsRaw: Blend: Add the basil, cashews, nutritional yeast, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper to a small food processor and blend until smooth. If needed, add 2–3 tablespoons water (or a little extra olive oil) to thin to your desired consistency.
Taste & adjust: Taste and adjust with more salt, lemon juice, or black pepper as needed.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 2 cups (1.6 oz) fresh basil leaves, loosely packed
▢ ¼ cup raw cashews, (or pine nuts or walnuts)
